// Broad California Regions to cover Northern, Central, and Southern CA
const CaliforniaRegions = [
  "California",
  "Los Angeles County, CA",
  "Orange County, CA",
  "San Diego County, CA",
  "San Francisco Bay Area, CA",
  "Sacramento Metro, CA",
  "Inland Empire, CA",
  "Central Valley, CA",
  "Silicon Valley, CA",
  "Central Coast, CA"
];

const searchQueries = [];

for (const cat of categories) {
  for (const region of CaliforniaRegions) {
    searchQueries.push({
      json: {
        category: cat,
        location: region,
        search_query: `${cat} in ${region}`
      }
    });
  }
}

// Shuffle queries randomly so every execution gets broad coverage across CA
searchQueries.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);

// Return 5 random queries per execution (Yields ~100 California businesses per run)
return searchQueries.slice(0,5);
